name: Transyver na horyshchi
source:
A group of radio amateurs receives a mysterious signal from an unknown station. Soon one of them disappears under mysterious circumstances.

Then another one.

Postgraduate student of Chernihiv Polytechnic University Bohdan Karpenko.

His sister Hanna goes in search. Mykola, a novice radio amateur, helps her because he liked Hanna at first sight.

But there are secrets in the world, the discover of which will have to pay a high price...

[Translated from [url=https://technix.itch.io/transceiver]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一群业余无线电爱好者收到来自未知电台的神秘信号。很快，其中一人神秘失踪。

然后是另一个。

切尔尼戈夫理工大学博赫丹·卡彭科研究生。

他的妹妹汉娜去寻找。米科拉是一名业余无线电爱好者，他帮助了她，因为他对汉娜一见钟情。

但世界上有一些秘密，发现这些秘密需要付出高昂的代价……
